rule: Every required movement category must bind at least one verified real-human evidence item before whole-body anatomical acceptance. Coverage is necessary but not sufficient: candidate-specific production-path visual/numerical evidence is still required.

categories.notes: Isolated healthy-adult trunk flexion; loaded exercise-specific surface validation still required.
Isolated healthy-adult trunk extension; loaded exercise-specific surface validation still required.
Isolated axial rotation plus dynamic sports motions; exercise-specific load response still required.
Isolated lateral flexion; loaded side-bend deformation still requires candidate evidence.
Asymmetric lifting supports anti-rotation/load-response principles but is not a Pallof-press-specific surface reference.
Bodyweight and loaded hip hinge evidence; detailed joint-angle surface validation still required.
Whole lower-limb 3D squat kinematics; candidate-specific deep-flexion skin/volume validation still required.
Forward-lunge lower-body kinematics; candidate-specific groin/hip tissue continuity still required.
Loaded heel-raise kinematics with multiple foot orientations; candidate Achilles/calf/forefoot deformation still required.
Closed- and open-chain push evidence across shoulder/elbow/wrist; hand/floor contact remains candidate-specific.
Direct shoulder-complex kinematics and surface-motion evidence; r96 candidate validation remains open.
Exercise-specific pull-up kinematics across front/wide/reverse grips; individual digit contact still candidate-specific.
Elevation and axial-rotation evidence covers general raise mechanics; model must pass full arc.
Healthy elbow flexion-extension and loaded chest-exercise motion; curl-specific soft tissue still requires candidate evidence.
Healthy isolated and closed/open-chain elbow extension evidence.
Pronation-supination and grip/load coupling evidence; candidate twist distribution remains to be proven.
Human push-up wrist load-path and upper-limb kinematics evidence; candidate contact/pressure remains to be proven.
Cylindrical joint-angle, thumb-adaptation and pull-up orientation evidence; exact dumbbell/bar contact still requires candidate review.
Measured thumb opposition/adaptation evidence; exact equipment contact still candidate-specific.

acceptance_boundary: Coverage entries do not close any whole-body issue.
No evidence item may be copied into production geometry, textures or runtime content.
A category remains blocked for final acceptance until production-path start/intermediate/end/reversal evidence is reviewed.
Numerical gates cannot override visibly implausible anatomy.
